operations.content: RPi trixie I2C layout: main bus GPIO2/3 = /dev/i2c-1 (0x3f804000), i2c-2=GPIO0/1; needs dtparam=i2c_arm=on + i2c-dev module. SunFounder I2C LCD1602 at 0x27 on i2c-1.

Debian python3-luma.lcd 2.10 API (differs from PyPI): pcf8574(port, address) from luma.core.interface.serial + hd44780(serial_interface=...); display.text is an observable property (assign, don't call). No css1602/serial_port in the Debian package.
